name: Supercharger AI — Ultimate Engagement Toolkit
author: codesupplyco

sections.description:
Supercharger AI is an AI-powered content engagement toolkit for WordPress. It enhances your posts with summaries, highlights, featured quotes, semantic recommendations, smart navigation, analytics and visitor-retention tools — all generated automatically in the background.

Designed to run on autopilot while keeping you in full control, Supercharger AI analyzes your content and adds AI-generated enhancements that help visitors discover more content, stay longer, and engage more deeply with your website. Content enhancement, discovery, retention, analytics and customization come together in a single lightweight plugin.

Learn more at wpsupercharger.com

Automation with full control

Supercharger AI works on autopilot, but you’re always in charge. With 12 modules to choose from, you decide which features to use, how they look, and where they appear:

  • Enable only the modules you want to use
  • Customize layouts, colors, typography and spacing
  • Edit or override any AI-generated content at any time
  • Control where each module appears across your website
  • Combine modules to build your ideal reading experience

Use a single module, a combination, or the complete toolkit — Supercharger AI adapts to your workflow instead of forcing a fixed setup.

What you get

Make content easier to consume. Help visitors quickly understand and navigate your content with AI-generated summaries, highlights, key questions, featured quotes and smart navigation.

Improve content discovery. Connect visitors with relevant content through semantic recommendations, inline suggestions, topic-based navigation and intelligent recirculation.

Increase engagement. Encourage visitors to keep exploring with contextual recommendations, smart navigation and enhanced reading experiences.

Recover lost visitors. Reduce bounce rates with retention modules that re-engage visitors even as they prepare to leave the page.

Track what works. Measure impressions, clicks, CTR and engagement trends with built-in analytics that show the impact of every module.

AI modules

Free

  • AI Paragraph Highlights — Highlights the most important paragraphs in an article so visitors can quickly identify key information.
  • AI Quote Puller — Extracts a compelling quote from your content and displays it as a visually engaging callout.
  • AI Recommendations — Suggests related articles using semantic relevance rather than categories or tags.

Pro

  • AI Content Summarizer — Generates concise summaries that help readers understand an article before diving in.
  • AI Key Moments — Creates a smart table of contents with quick-jump navigation to important sections.
  • AI Key Questions — Surfaces the key questions your content answers and links directly to the relevant sections.
  • AI Excerpts — Generates contextual excerpts for archives, listings and previews.
  • AI Inline Recommendations — Displays contextual “Read Also” recommendations within the article.
  • AI Continue Reading Chips — Adds topic-based navigation chips that encourage further exploration.
  • AI Smart Up-Next — Shows the next recommended article as visitors approach the end of a post.
  • AI Footer Recirculation — Promotes additional relevant content after visitors finish reading.
  • AI Exit-Intent Recirculation — Displays a relevant recommendation when a visitor shows signs of leaving.

See all modules and upgrade to Pro

Free vs Pro

The free version includes AI Paragraph Highlights, AI Quote Puller, AI Recommendations and full visual customization — everything you need to start adding AI-powered engagement to your website.

Supercharger AI Pro unlocks all 12 modules, advanced analytics, a real-time interactive design preview, dark mode and priority support. Learn more and upgrade at wpsupercharger.com.

Your AI, your rules

Supercharger AI uses your own AI provider key — OpenAI, Anthropic, DeepSeek or OpenRouter. Nothing runs until you connect your key and choose which modules to activate. Content is generated in the background and served pre-rendered to visitors, so your front-end stays fast.

Built by a Power Elite author

Supercharger AI is developed by Code Supply Co., a Power Elite ThemeForest author with 30,000+ licenses sold and more than 120,000 customers worldwide. That means clean code built to WordPress coding standards, regular updates with new features and compatibility fixes, and reliable support from a team committed to long-term product quality.

Multilingual ready

Supercharger AI is fully translation-ready and ships with built-in translations for 5 languages: English, German, French, Spanish and Russian.

Development

The complete source code and build instructions are available in the public GitHub repository. The full, human-readable source also ships inside this plugin itself.

External services

AI provider API

Generates the AI content the modules display. When you run generation, the post content and metadata, the active prompt, and your selected model and API key are sent to the AI provider you choose in Settings. Semantic indexing (embeddings) always uses OpenAI. Configure one generation provider:

  • OpenAI, L.L.C. — terms, privacy
  • Anthropic, PBC (Claude) — terms, privacy
  • DeepSeek — terms, privacy
  • OpenRouter — terms, privacy

Google Fonts

When a module uses a Google-hosted font, the visitor’s browser loads it directly from Google (sending its IP and User-Agent; no site content). Pick a system font to avoid this. Provided by Google LLC — terms, privacy.
sections.installation:
1. Install Supercharger from Plugins → Add New, or upload the plugin ZIP via Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Supercharger → Settings, choose your AI provider and add its API key.
  4. Enable the modules you want and let Supercharger generate enhancements in the background.
sections.faq:
Do I need an API key?

Yes. Supercharger connects to your chosen AI provider (OpenAI, Anthropic, DeepSeek or OpenRouter) using a key you provide in the plugin settings, so you stay in control of usage and billing. Semantic indexing (embeddings) always uses OpenAI. See the External services section below for what is sent and when.

Does Supercharger slow down my site?

No. AI generation runs in the background via WordPress cron, never on the page-view request. Generated content is cached per post, so visitors get the same fast page load whether AI features are enabled or not.

What is the difference between the free and Pro versions?

The free version includes three modules (AI Paragraph Highlights, AI Quote Puller, AI Recommendations) and full visual customization. Pro unlocks all 12 modules, advanced analytics, a real-time design preview, dark mode and priority support. See wpsupercharger.com.

Will it work with my theme?

Supercharger is designed to work with most modern WordPress themes and lets you customize colors, typography and spacing so each module matches your design.
sections.changelog:
1.0.3

Improvements
* Continue Reading Chips widget hover color in dark mode now follows the secondary color setting.
* Quote Puller widget icon in the Minimal preset is now fully opaque for better visibility.
* Refreshed styling for the Summary widget Minimal preset.
* Excerpt text color now uses the secondary color variable for more consistent theming.
* Removed box shadows from the Outline preset for a cleaner look.
* Secondary text elements (descriptions, previews, labels) in Continue Reading Chips, Exit Intent, Inline Recommendations, Key Moments, and Key Questions now have consistent font sizing.
* Widgets now correctly adjust their top and bottom spacing when placed first or last inside parent container.
* Improved compatibility of the AI Excerpts module with third-party SEO plugins.

Bug Fixes
* Fixed AI badge not displaying correctly in the Embedded style preset for Exit Intent and Quote Puller widgets
* Fixed arrow icon color in Key Moments and Key Questions widgets — now renders correctly in both light and dark modes
* Fixed visual issues with the Minimal style preset in Key Moments and Key Questions widgets
* Fixed missing border and shadow controls in Inline Recommendations, Key Moments, and Continue Reading Chips widgets
* Fixed arrow icons in right-to-left (RTL) language layouts.

1.0.2

  • Raised the minimum required PHP version to 8.0 to match the features the plugin already uses.

1.0.1

  • Choose your AI generation provider — OpenAI, Anthropic (Claude), DeepSeek or OpenRouter — each with current models. Semantic indexing (embeddings) continues to use OpenAI.
  • Combined daily spending limit and usage tracking across all providers.
  • Added translations: German (de_DE), Spanish (es_ES), French (fr_FR), Russian (ru_RU).
  • Regenerated and updated the .pot template file.
  • Improved the responsive layout of the admin screens (settings, dashboard, logs, statistics and the module dialog) on tablet and mobile.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
